ModMetaData.name: RimMandrake: Pyrinth
ModMetaData.author: Mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
Absorbed copy of det.epochspyrinth ("Epochs - Pyrinth"): the glowing orange pyrinth ore, its torch/wall-torch/pylon/heater furniture family and its sparking mote effects (the donor's pyrinth blade is not absorbed: owner, 2026-10-19, "not needed") (CRYSTAL_INGEST_EXECUTION_1 item 1, design/Jawa/mods/crystal_mods_inventory.md). Generic content, no Star Wars or campaign material === RimMandrake tier per design/NAMING_SCHEME_PLAN.md.
det.epochspyrinth was retired from the mod list (retirement wave 1, 2026-10-19) and this pack preserves its defNames verbatim, so loading both together collides (hence incompatibleWith). The Lantern-Deeps natural-scatter gate (CRYSTAL_INGEST_EXECUTION_1's actual live-effect deliverable) lives in src/RimMandrake/LanternDeeps/Patches/RM_LanternDeepGatePyrinth.xml.
